provenance.selection: Independently per view, sort failures by pixelY, pixelX, original array index. Seed the first. Repeatedly choose the pixel maximizing squared distance to its nearest selected pixel until 48 are selected. Break ties by the same sorted order. No filtering against candidate results.
provenance.coordinateConversion: Blender [x,y,z] to Three [x,z,-y], applied to origins and directions without decimal rounding
